title: Show ferry departures in port time
prompt: Show each ferry departure in the local time of its port. Implement `local_departure(utc_time, port)` in timetable.py: it gets a timezone-aware UTC datetime and a port name, and returns the departure as a datetime in that port's local time.
notes: zoneinfo knows every daylight-saving rule. The lazy-wrong version uses fixed summer offsets and is wrong half the year; the bloated version hand-codes the DST rules.
extension: Add `local_departure_text(utc_time, port)` returning e.g. 'Sun 29 Mar 02:30 BST'.
